task.title: DIAGNOSED: Sep 27/28 Strength reviews never created — aligned match skipped Founder review while auto-confirm is off; fix ready, NOT deployed

result.summary: Both days share one Server root cause: a CONFIDENT, gate-eligible Strength match was excluded from Founder review on the assumption auto-confirm would handle it, but production policy v4 has linkAutoConfirm=false (since Sep 25). Links stayed 'candidate' with no evidenceReviews record, so Log had nothing pending and Native's local notifier had nothing to fire on. Fix: skip review only when auto-confirm will actually run now. After deploy, the next routine HealthKit ingest creates exactly two pending reviews (Sep 27, Sep 28); nothing else is stranded or reopened. No Native build needed.
